interpretation: The new profile can fit the training images; held-out accuracy is below the preregistered threshold and the same-data 4NN baseline.
The training/test gap establishes poor generalization, but does not isolate regularization, invariance, capacity or data coverage as its sole cause.
Earlier 1000/200 development results are not a matched final comparison with the 6000/2000 final protocol.
Timing, whole-image representation, encoder capacity/trainability and objective changes are explicit; gains are not attributed solely to timing.
This artificial continuous example core uses no connectome, chemistry, receptor, LIF or local-plasticity mechanism.

limitations: Not natural page OCR or a generally useful OCR model.
The full framework test suite was executed on this Mac; skipped hardware or optional integration cases remain skipped.
No full-brain task quality or biological-mechanism benefit is demonstrated.
